label.explanation: Notification-svc picked up config revision 645, which changed TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to port 8081 (lines 236, 243). template-svc doesn't listen there, so every call is refused immediately (lines 248, 256, 258, 271) — not a timeout, and template-svc itself is healthy (its routine logs continue). The api-gateway 503s are the symptom (lines 251, 255, 260, 265, 274, 281, 288, 291, 300, 303, 309, 312). The config revision shipped with the notification-svc v3.13.0 deploy, so bad_deploy is defensible, but the fault is the config value. Red herrings: lines 226, 234 (a deploy of notif-worker, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally); lines 64, 65 (a single email provider connection reset that succeeded on retry, minutes before onset); line 227 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path).
